# OMK (Open Multi-Agent Kit)

> Open-source, MIT-licensed coding agent CLI for the terminal, written in TypeScript. Switch models in one session, add subagents when needed, and mark a goal done only when a check you choose passes (`/goal verify`).

Install: `npm install -g open-multi-agent-kit --ignore-scripts` (Node.js 22.19+), or `curl -fsSL https://github.com/dmae97/omk/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` for the standalone binary. Then run `omk` in your project.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/dmae97/omk/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start, defaults, FAQ
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/dmae97/omk/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/index.md)
- [Providers](https://github.com/dmae97/omk/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md): subscriptions, API keys, local models
- [Goal demo](https://github.com/dmae97/omk/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/goal-demo.md): a small reproducible `/goal verify` run
- [Run protocol](https://github.com/dmae97/omk/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/docs/run-protocol.md)
